headlines.title: Cousins stays as Raiders starter after Mendoza debut

headlines.title: Giants and Commanders tie after clock blunder
headlines.summary: Washington didn't stop the clock, which set up a possible game-winning field goal. The game ended in a tie. Dan Quinn said he is still furious.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Giants are 3–1–1 and third in the NFC.

contextCard.title: How the NFL injury report works
contextCard.body: Before games, teams list players as Out, Doubtful or Questionable. Out means the player won't play. Doubtful means he is unlikely to play, and Questionable means it's uncertain. Designations can change as the week goes on, so a Questionable player can be cleared or ruled out late.
